population: All retained 1737 and 481 five-league European goal+closing market fixtures. Missing any complete, valid same-book closing AH pair is reported.
benchmark: The fixed same-book 1X2 + actual 2.5 total closing Bet365 projection of the same joint goal prior.
candidate: Add same-book Bet365 closing Asian handicap AHCh (home perspective), B365CAHH (home), B365CAHA (away). Convert the home adjusted score difference to average net stake result s over the two split quarter lines or the single half/integer line. De-vig the two decimal quotes by normalized reciprocals for fair home share q. On each matrix cell f=max(s,0)-q*abs(s). Starting at benchmark, use M(theta) proportional to benchmark*exp(theta*f) then reproject to the exact original WDL and totals targets. Fit one fixture-specific tilt to E_M[f]+0.01*theta=0; coefficient, data, sample and outcomes fixed before scoring. No model training or retrospective selection.
source: Historical earlier/closing labels as archived; the comparison only uses closing columns and cannot certify individual original quote time.
score_metrics: strict actual O/U full win excluding push
